targetDomain: Pinned syntax-family catalogue of consumed direct string comparisons, switch labels, literal keyword dispatch handler names and existing lens/list-action constants; no complete Canvas interface schema is inferred.
forwardMap: Observe the exact current canvas renderer AST and compare every observed family/label with the committed catalogue. Public runtime lens/list-action vocabulary is projected from the constants actually used by current consumers.
partiality: Closed only for the explicitly observed syntax families. Computed/indirect labels, extension vocabularies, slot cardinality and full authored type closure remain unproved.
failure: The characterization test refuses additions/removals/reclassification or stale source SHA; runtime lens normalization retains its existing explicit options fallback.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host operations remain with the caller/server; no generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production execution grant follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns input program/capabilities; current client memory/controller own their local state. Returned snapshots have detached persistent values; explicit runtime evidence references remain shared where documented.
evidence: Hand-authored normative JSON cases plus semantic-translation-inspector-canvas.test.mjs in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps, with a pinned AST vocabulary catalogue.
default: Current public compatibility defaults remain explicit: omitted network uses authored net configuration, unknown lens mode selects options, absent transfer format uses REL, and omitted optional UI fields are sanitized. Retained no-default extraction intent is not asserted restored.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

sourceDomain: Explicit injected appender, publisher, telemetry event host, renderer controller and motion/placement commit callbacks at current browser boundaries.
targetDomain: Current explicit callback boundaries in persistence, renderer telemetry and interaction controllers; no generic host-effect executor or full canvas extraction is restored.
forwardMap: Invoke the named current public operations and the actual shared browser call sites. Current explicit callback boundaries in persistence, renderer telemetry and interaction controllers; no generic host-effect executor or full canvas extraction is restored.
preservedInformation: Observed command/revision, stage/detail, controller callback identity and ordered outcome/refusal at the selected seams.
lostInformation: Host scheduling, complete request protocol, generic effect receipts, rasterization and unobserved capabilities are not reconstructed.
identity: Caller capability instance, current command/page or interaction context; no generic effectRequest identity is synthesized.
partiality: Only these named host seams are qualified. EventSource, storage, scheduler, rasterization and arbitrary effect requests remain outside this contract translation.
failure: Host semantic effect failures propagate; observation failures are contained. No local host result grants production or scientific acceptance.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host invocations remain with their caller/server; no generic algebra, execution grant or scientific authority follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns injected capability; registry/controller own their local state; server owns save admission.
evidence: Hand-authored normative cases and semantic-translation-browser-host.test.mjs executed in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps; these are bounded witnesses, not universal semantic equivalence.
falsifier: An observer failure retries an accepted save, an unregistered inherited renderer resolves, or a throwing commit leaves an active interaction.
default: Current public API compatibility defaults are retained where supplied by the implementation; retained no-default extraction intent is not claimed restored.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

sourceDomain: Current canvas viewState/runtime.workbenchUi and explicit session or named-draft snapshot records.
targetDomain: Detached persistent view state and sanitized UI snapshot, or restored current memory with current transient editor/history state preserved.
forwardMap: Use actual shared canvas snapshot/restore functions; deep-copy persistent/draft values, omit session buffers/history/callbacks/previews, preserve lens/inspection alias inside each snapshot and refuse malformed top-level snapshot records before mutation. Treat prototype-named draft entries as own properties.
partiality: Bounded JSON-compatible snapshots, valid state records and selected sanitation rules. Unknown-subject validation, complete window/viewport persistence, every storage adapter fault and a generic pure transition planner remain unproved.
failure: Malformed snapshot records refuse with invalid-workbench-snapshot; non-cloneable host values retain clone failures. Persisted malformed JSON no longer masquerades as successful empty restore.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Explicit host operations remain with the caller/server; no generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production execution grant follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns input program/capabilities; current client memory/controller own their local state. Returned snapshots have detached persistent values; explicit runtime evidence references remain shared where documented.
evidence: Hand-authored normative JSON cases plus semantic-translation-inspector-canvas.test.mjs in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps, with a pinned AST vocabulary catalogue.
default: Current public compatibility defaults remain explicit: omitted network uses authored net configuration, unknown lens mode selects options, absent transfer format uses REL, and omitted optional UI fields are sanitized. Retained no-default extraction intent is not asserted restored.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

sourceDomain: Explicit current net RouteTarget records with own nonempty subjects, role/subject selectors, string URL/path/query inputs, origin options or current browser origin and optional authored overrides.
targetDomain: Exact target identity, explicit absence/empty-path sentinel, canonical surface URL or same-origin API path/query, with typed refusals before caller mutation.
forwardMap: Use actual shared frontend routing functions. Refuse malformed/ambiguous targets and inherited coordinates. Preserve authored href overrides, empty-path absence and root-path distinction. Check origins, API URL origins, endpoint segments and port range; preserve surface query/hash and forward explicit origin options through both sibling endpoint helpers.
lostInformation: URL normalization canonicalizes default ports/escaping. API query/sibling projections intentionally omit fragments; sibling endpoints clear prior query. Explicit target identity and caller input remain available unchanged.
partiality: Current string URL inputs and compatible option records. API query/sibling helpers require matching HTTP(S) origins; an authored surface port may differ. Explicit href and endpoint overrides remain caller-authorized values, not fetch admission. Native URL parameter-conversion faults propagate.
failure: Missing targets/origins and invalid target shape, ambiguity, origin, cross-origin API retargeting, endpoint and port have explicit codes. No implicit retarget to the current origin or silent invalid-port fallback is allowed.
authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Pure projections do not grant authority; explicit filesystem/import effects remain with their caller and loader. No generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production admission follows.
evidence: Hand-authored normative cases plus semantic-translation-browser-boundary.test.mjs against actual default/source/registry/hit-test/routing functions in source, assembled SDK and both isolated bootstraps.
default: Absent target lists remain fresh empty lists; null lists preserve the existing absence policy. Missing option objects use current compatibility defaults; ambient browser origin is read only when no explicit origin is supplied. Empty sibling bases use root, empty save URL uses the current /save endpoint, and empty target paths remain empty rather than inventing root.

identity: One mapping per lane with last admitted mapping winning, and one key per normalized project/partition/lane tuple; percent and colon are escaped independently.
evidence: Injected-storage witnesses cover key coordinate identity, a 216-tuple collision oracle, alias mapping, unsupported adapter, wire round trip, absence/corruption/version and exact get/set fault identity. Native global storage remains unproved.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

records.subject: module.browserPublicationApplication

sourceDomain: Current explicit caller memory, named lanes, backend/frontend publication metadata and event-role alias inputs.
targetDomain: Caller-owned lane/queue/revision/projection transitions and current Boolean changed result; no standalone generic effect planner is restored.
forwardMap: Normalize current role aliases, preflight known lane destinations, apply publication data, and update revision/projection custody only after successful application. Backend revision is no longer written before delegation.
partiality: Valid caller runtime and FactStore lanes for named destinations. No destination is an explicit no-op. Sequenced stale events refuse changes; unsequenced compatibility inputs retain current behavior.
failure: Typed invalid-runtime/lane refusals and malformed-S failures occur before checked queue/lane/revision/projection mutations. Rollback for arbitrary caller getters or throwing substitute stores is unproved.
authorityEffect: Mutates only supplied caller memory through the existing lane engine. No application activation, remote publication permission or scientific admission is inferred.
stateOwner: Caller owns memory, queues, lane stores and publication metadata; the operation owns temporary normalization/preflight data.
evidence: Role alias, unknown event, stale metadata, missing-destination atomicity, backend clock and public snapshot/delta cases, plus async malformed-payload tests.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

sourceDomain: Current caller-owned runtime, valid FactStore lane destinations, canonical facts/deltas and publication metadata at the public browser delivery boundary.
targetDomain: Actual caller-memory lane, pending-queue and role-specific high-water transitions; this is not the retained pure planning API.
forwardMap: Preflight destinations and checked pending decode before queue/lane mutation, reject sequenced stale events, retain later pending local overlays, and use collision-free functional/type coordinate tuples for materialization.
reverseMapOrAbsence: Next current lane/runtime state does not reconstruct prior histories or acknowledged queue entries; no retained pure transition receipt is restored.
preservedInformation: Checked facts, functional slot/type identities, role aliases, later pending local facts, revisions and role-specific monotonic publication clocks.
lostInformation: Acknowledged queue entries, superseded functional values, input wire aliases and private planning/receipt identities.
identity: Serialized [prop,subject,predicate] or [isa,subject,type] tuple for materialization, plus separate frontend and backend safe sequence clocks.
partiality: Current named valid lane/store inputs and canonical payloads. Unknown named destinations refuse; no destination is a no-op. Unsequenced compatibility events do not establish monotonic delivery guarantees.
failure: Current typed lane/runtime and malformed-S refusals preserve the checked preimage. General transactional rollback for arbitrary host-mutator faults remains unproved.
authorityEffect: Mutates supplied caller lane/runtime state through existing engine operations; this is an explicit amendment of the retained effect-plan-only claim.
stateOwner: Caller memory owns durable/published/optimistic lanes and custody. Host/server authority is not synthesized by delivery qualification.
evidence: Counterexamples and normative cases plus sequence-order oracle, delimiter-bearing coordinate product, malformed payload and missing-lane preimage tests.
default: Current explicit compatibility defaults are recorded: absent/invalid sequence is zero, role alias preference is preserved and unknown event/no destination returns false.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

authorityEffect: Bounded current runtime qualification only. Pure projections do not grant authority; explicit filesystem/import effects remain with their caller and loader. No generic executable algebra, scientific acceptance or production admission follows.

records.subject: module.resetCandidate

sourceDomain: Explicit canonical string-valued FactStore fixtures or normalized value records supplied to deriveResetCandidateInventory. Active membership and dependency indexes are caller-supplied Sets/Maps where required.
targetDomain: Current owning JavaScript projections, ordered fact/artifact arrays, Set membership or exact refusals reached by the listed normative cases. The former sdk/plugins/data-space/reset-candidate.rel decomposition is retained as specification evidence, not reconstituted as generic execution.
forwardMap: Current reset inventory considers own policy ranks only; unknown labels, including Object.prototype names, use explicit -1 fallback. Equal-rank conflicting fallback candidates remain blocked. Normal value-resolution policy is separately retained.
reverseMapOrAbsence: No inverse is claimed. Projections/defaults and rendered serializations cannot reconstruct omitted facts, original container shapes or source-history identity.
preservedInformation: Selected authored subject, owner, property, role and value coordinates and ordering asserted by these cases. Shared dependency identity is verified only by focused identity tests where explicitly present.
lostInformation: Unobserved source fields, original optional-value distinctions, fact-store provenance, source formatting and historical module boundaries are not reconstructed.
identity: Authored subject/owner/property coordinates at the current implementation boundary. This does not establish identity of historical callback instances or generic execution receipts.
partiality: Finite canonical fixtures with explicit compatible context qualify reached current branches only. Arbitrary host objects, getters, concurrent store mutation, exhaustive nested editor combinations and generic algebra equivalence remain unproved.
failure: The listed type, ownership, active-membership, required-field and vocabulary refusals are asserted against current errors. Unreached failure branches and historical error identity remain unproved.
authorityEffect: Specification translation and bounded current runtime qualification only. No source-authority recovery, scientific acceptance, production execution, connector access or generic dynamic execution grant follows.
stateOwner: Caller owns fact store, input records, active membership and dependency indexes. Parser owns transient projected containers; indexed dependency records may remain shared. Editor values describe proposed scopes without executing writes.
evidence: Hand-authored normative cases foundation-reset-conflict; semantic-translation-data-space-foundation.test.mjs supplies separate focused regression witnesses. Source, fresh assembly and isolated bootstrap receipts are required before checkpoint qualification.
falsifier: Any listed expected value/order/refusal fails, a scope mutation passes a required ownership guard, or current source/artifact/bundle hashes disagree. Passing this bounded witness set does not falsify the still-open generic-architecture gap.
default: Current compatibility defaults reached by the listed cases remain explicit: omitted labels/text/arrays and numeric order commonly become empty/zero; specific scalar fallbacks, widget kinds, suppression rank and policy fallbacks follow current owners. A default-free generic subsystem is not claimed.

sourceDomain: Ordered canonical string-coordinate fact histories supplied as arrays, FactStore, wrappers or toArray adapters to the current public route declaration validators.
targetDomain: Ordered normalized declaration diagnostics or an explicit successful admission result; old route-command parameter compilation is unproved.
forwardMap: Fold retractions and reassertions into a fresh active snapshot, then run current route action, page renderer, startup resource and route-target declaration checks.
reverseMapOrAbsence: Diagnostics retain available fact source coordinates, but do not recover the complete history, private index or command execution receipt.
preservedInformation: Active declaration coordinates, selected provenance and current typed failure data for the checked cases.
lostInformation: Retracted entries, superseded identical assertions, input container identity and unselected declaration history.
identity: Unambiguous serialized subject/predicate/object tuple and per-call owned snapshot, rather than caller array identity.
partiality: Canonical string-coordinate fact inputs compatible with current route declaration APIs; generic route command/parameter algebra is not qualified.
failure: Current AdmissibilityError with normalized issues or returned declaration diagnostics; no missing command/permission execution proof is inferred.
authorityEffect: Read-only declaration observation; this gate grants no route execution permission.
stateOwner: Caller owns source histories; validator owns fresh active snapshot and local index.
evidence: Retraction/reassertion, mutable array reuse, source-form parity, target refusal, typed admission and independent bounded active-history oracle.
falsifier: Retracted keyword authorizes an action, removed route produces a diagnostic, or changed caller array reuses a stale index.
default: Empty declaration facts yield successful admission; this is not a grant to execute an absent route or command.

forwardMap: Use the existing separate policy and expression implementations with explicit owner types, active inventories, exact edit-target target/predicate guards and current canonical child ordering. The shared retained callback-driven generic decomposition is not restored. Guarded owner/scope failures propagate without an authority-granting fallback.
partiality: Finite authored fact fixtures, explicitly indexed owner dependencies and normalized string-valued contexts qualify reached current branches. Arbitrary host objects, concurrent fact-store mutation during a cached resolution, external effects and generic callback/decomposition equivalence remain unproved.
authorityEffect: Bounded current trusted-bridge parser, editor-plan and local eligibility qualification only. These projections grant no source authority, scientific acceptance, external execution or generic algebra restoration.
stateOwner: Caller owns the fact store, explicit active sets/maps and normalized context. Current parser/resolver owns its ephemeral caches and projections; indexed dependency objects may be shared. Editor plans describe scoped proposals without executing writes.
evidence: Explicit normative parser, vocabulary, resolver, editor and runtime eligibility cases plus semantic-translation-trusted-bridge.test.mjs covering shared identity, cross-owner refusal in both cache orders and nested four-kind mutation scope.

records.selection: Complete retained obligations selected; sparse reconstitution intent, if present, remains recorded as a separate variant.

stateOwner: Caller owns the fact store, explicit active sets/maps and normalized context. Current parser/resolver owns its ephemeral caches and projections; indexed dependency objects may be shared. Editor plans describe scoped proposals without executing writes.
evidence: Explicit normative parser, vocabulary, resolver, editor and runtime eligibility cases plus semantic-translation-trusted-bridge.test.mjs covering shared identity, cross-owner refusal in both cache orders and nested four-kind mutation scope.

Arbitrary host objects, concurrent fact-store mutation during a cached resolution, external effects and generic callback/decomposition equivalence remain unproved.
authorityEffect: Bounded current trusted-bridge parser, editor-plan and local eligibility qualification only. These projections grant no source authority, scientific acceptance, external execution or generic algebra restoration.
stateOwner: Caller owns the fact store, explicit active sets/maps and normalized context. Current parser/resolver owns its ephemeral caches and projections; indexed dependency objects may be shared. Editor plans describe scoped proposals without executing writes.
evidence: Explicit normative parser, vocabulary, resolver, editor and runtime eligibility cases plus semantic-translation-trusted-bridge.test.mjs covering shared identity, cross-owner refusal in both cache orders and nested four-kind mutation scope.

forwardMap: Use the existing separate policy and expression implementations with explicit owner types, active inventories, exact edit-target target/predicate guards and current canonical child ordering. The shared retained callback-driven generic decomposition is not restored. Guarded owner/scope failures propagate without an authority-granting fallback.
partiality: Finite authored fact fixtures, explicitly indexed owner dependencies and normalized string-valued contexts qualify reached current branches. Arbitrary host objects, concurrent fact-store mutation during a cached resolution, external effects and generic callback/decomposition equivalence remain unproved.
authorityEffect: Bounded current trusted-bridge parser, editor-plan and local eligibility qualification only. These projections grant no source authority, scientific acceptance, external execution or generic algebra restoration.
stateOwner: Caller owns the fact store, explicit active sets/maps and normalized context. Current parser/resolver owns its ephemeral caches and projections; indexed dependency objects may be shared. Editor plans describe scoped proposals without executing writes.
evidence: Explicit normative parser, vocabulary, resolver, editor and runtime eligibility cases plus semantic-translation-trusted-bridge.test.mjs covering shared identity, cross-owner refusal in both cache orders and nested four-kind mutation scope.

forwardMap: Evaluate normalized conditions, nested all/any groups and expression sets, then select the first matching rule in the supplied policy order. Unknown/missing operators, unknown signals, unknown/empty group logic, missing/mistyped member or pattern operands and absent numeric evidence cannot become positive eligibility evidence. Legacy constraints are synthesized only when a policy has no explicit rules.
partiality: Explicit finite normalized context/policy graphs are witnessed. Parsed graphs reject cycles before runtime; arbitrary cyclic hand-built policy graphs and external execution are outside these witnesses.
failure: Malformed pattern compilation yields no match. Empty rules/groups/sets and failed operands do not match. Parse/type/owner refusals remain separate. This is a local eligibility projection, not a capability or scientific admission.
authorityEffect: Bounded current trusted-bridge parser, editor-plan and local eligibility qualification only. These projections grant no source authority, scientific acceptance, external execution or generic algebra restoration.
stateOwner: Caller owns the fact store, explicit active sets/maps and normalized context. Current parser/resolver owns its ephemeral caches and projections; indexed dependency objects may be shared. Editor plans describe scoped proposals without executing writes.
evidence: Explicit normative parser, vocabulary, resolver, editor and runtime eligibility cases plus semantic-translation-trusted-bridge.test.mjs covering shared identity, cross-owner refusal in both cache orders and nested four-kind mutation scope.
default: An explicitly empty supplied policy list returns the historical null policy/rule pair and grants no match. No implicit equals operator or all group logic is used. The separate context-listing path still has two hard-coded compatibility family policies; that default-authority debt remains open.
